data.future_boundary: canonical temporal test plus Phase 3.5 authoritative Fold 1, Fold 2, Fold 3
data.historical_skip_node_limitation: historical seven skipped-node identities remain unrecoverable

common_rules.training: fit candidate components only within each training boundary
common_rules.validation: use only the declared validation portion for threshold/policy calibration
common_rules.future_evaluation: evaluate once on each frozen future regime; never select using future results
common_rules.preprocessing: training-fitted median imputation and standardization where applicable
common_rules.calibration: preserve V1 isotonic calibration; no replacement unless separately preregistered
common_rules.tuning: no grid search, random search, Bayesian optimization, repeated temporal tuning, or test-set selection
common_rules.randomness: deterministic seed 3637 and explicitly serialized configuration
common_rules.comparison: direct frozen-V1 comparison with absolute, mean, median, and worst-fold deltas

candidates.name: structured_uncertainty_evidence_request
candidates.hypothesis: A structured uncertainty signal combined with bounded contextual evidence can improve decision safety without the coverage failure of standalone threshold abstention.
candidates.architecture: Frozen V1 calibrated risk -> frozen uncertainty signal -> deterministic evidence-request policy -> predict/warn/request-evidence/escalate action.
candidates.features: Frozen V1 14-feature numeric input plus no unregistered predictive features; context is derived only from training-available evidence.
candidates.policy: Predeclare one validation-locked policy with fixed action costs and a minimum useful-coverage gate; evidence request is bounded and cannot mutate V1.
acceptance: useful coverage remains above the predeclared gate
decision-safety or selective-risk improvement versus V1 is positive on the aggregate and not negative on every future fold
rejection: coverage below gate without compensating safety benefit

candidates.name: provenance_aware_failure_memory_context
candidates.hypothesis: Temporally eligible, provenance-tagged historical failure memory can improve current risk interpretation without modifying the frozen V1 predictor.
candidates.architecture: Current workload -> frozen V1 risk plus prior-only memory retrieval -> bounded contextual decision assessment -> safe action or escalation.
candidates.features: Frozen V1 14-feature numeric input; memory fields are contextual metadata and are not added to V1 training or V1 prediction.
candidates.policy: Use a fixed retrieval rule, explicit empty-memory behavior, provenance display, age/quality bounds, and validation-locked action mapping.
acceptance: measurable decision-quality or safety benefit versus no-memory control
memory overhead and retrieval behavior remain bounded and reproducible
rejection: benefit depends on one fold only
no measurable benefit over no-memory control

screening_status: No candidate-specific model or policy experiment was executed in the discovery/design phase; this file freezes the design boundary for a later screening phase.
